lead_raw_text:
The structure of Zn₂Si₂N₄ (ZnSiN₂) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Pmn2₁ (No. 31), with eight atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Si centers coordinated by six N neighbors and tetrahedral Zn centers coordinated by four N neighbors; the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component. Polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner-sharing between Si octahedra and Zn tetrahedra, edge-sharing between Si octahedra, and both corner- and edge-sharing between Zn tetrahedra.
